Name: No Blink
Author: brightonmorris1
Description:
No Blink removes farmer blinking from the game. This is largely intended for use with mods that drastically change the farmer's head sprites.

Deals the annoying design of farmer blinking being: 

[b]A. [/b]Hardcoded into the rendering of the game

[b]B.[/b] Having un-adjustable height or width

[b]C. [/b]Having a forced skin color

(By completely removing blinking, I'm not smart enough to touch rendering. Maybe one day I'll come back with a better design.)

-------------------------------

Now you can use that cool protogen farmer reskin without having bizarre blinking sprites ruining your day.
